svg.title: Uno R3 and ADXL335 Analog Outputs

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: ADXL335 breakout: 3V3, X, Y, Z, GND

g.desc: ADXL335 breakout: 3V3, X, Y, Z, GND

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: X/Y/Z outputs connect to Uno A0/A1/A2. Keep each output within the ADC input limits. Bare ADXL335 ICs require the recommended bypass capacitors; breakout boards vary. ERC and net assertions check this pin map only; physical operation is untested.

g.desc: X/Y/Z outputs connect to Uno A0/A1/A2. Keep each output within the ADC input limits. Bare ADXL335 ICs require the recommended bypass capacitors; breakout boards vary. ERC and net assertions check this pin map only; physical operation is untested.

g.text: J1 is a logical breakout connector: 1=3.3 V, 2=XOUT, 3=YOUT, 4=ZOUT, 5=GND. The drawing does not show the physical package layout. Verify whether the board supports the Uno 3.3 V output and check its labels.
